$comment: AEP-0002 Annex A machine-usable mapping fixture for the Antigravity table (the five-hook hooks.json command system shared by Antigravity 2.0 and the Antigravity CLI; DOCS provenance — the binary is closed: pinned against the official hooks documentation at antigravity.google/docs/hooks, fetched 2026-07-12, whose worked examples are these inputs' basis, plus the vendor's public changelog: CLI 1.1.1 current, 1.0.16 MINIMUM — the version whose changelog pins the safely-handled empty decision string that makes an observe-only PreToolUse reply possible; desktop 2.2.1; design record: docs/components/adapter-antigravity-design.md). Each entry pins the pure (hook, payload) -> events mapping at the adapter default posture (capture metadata): NO payload names its own hook event, so every entry carries the `hook` the registration argv supplies; PostToolUse entries carry the daemon's `join` result where one exists — the payload itself has NO tool name, and the registry requires one on tool.completed/tool.failed, so unjoined completions fall back to x.antigravity.step.completed (a name is never invented) and a dangling PreToolUse synthesizes NOTHING (denied/rejected/still-running are indistinguishable; approval outcomes are NOT hook-visible on this surface — no tool.denied, no attention.*). Envelope identity (conversationId -> session verbatim; session.started on first sight, NO session.ended ever; runs SYNTHESIZED — opened at the first invocation boundary, closed by Stop's typed terminationReason; the join table; the envelope step from the open invocation) is runtime state, pinned by the reference adapter smoke. There is NO payload schema-version sentinel — drift detection is the docs page and the vendor changelog watch.

identity.$comment: conversationId rides verbatim (a real UUID). No run id is on the wire (executionNum appears only at Stop, kept as metadata) — the adapter mints run ids; PreInvocation/PostInvocation set the envelope step from invocationNum.

pre_tool_use.$comment: the docs' worked example: the ONLY hook carrying the tool name and args — it feeds the (conversationId, stepIdx) join; args digest at metadata, whole args redacted+; step_idx IS the join key, said so

pre_tool_use_question_tool.$comment: the vendor's interaction tools are observed as TOOLS (their own shape) — never re-mapped onto attention.*: the user's answer is not hook-visible

post_tool_use_ok_joined.$comment: the THIN payload (stepIdx + error only): the daemon's join supplies the name the registry requires; an empty error is a completion

post_tool_use_error_joined.$comment: a non-empty error is the vendor's own failure fact: tool.failed, message redacted-gated

post_tool_use_unjoined.$comment: no join entry (restart, matcher gap, mid-conversation attach): the honest-absence fallback — a tool name is NEVER invented (unlike AG-UI's name-unknown case this wire keeps no call id, only a positional index)

post_tool_use_unjoined_error.$comment: the unjoined failure keeps the outcome fact; the message is redacted-gated (absent at the default posture)

pre_invocation.$comment: a model invocation is a vendor-declared sub-run phase: run.step.started with invocationNum setting the envelope step (the second live source for the family). Run synthesis (run.started when no run is open) is runtime state, smoke-pinned

post_invocation.$comment: wire-INDISTINGUISHABLE from PreInvocation ("Input Fields: Same as PreInvocation") — the registration argv is the discriminator; the mapping claims only the boundary fact

stop_model_stop.$comment: the typed terminationReason closes the synthesized run; executionNum and fullyIdle ride as metadata

stop_max_steps_exceeded.$comment: a bounded termination is a COMPLETION with the reason as metadata (the ACP stopReason rule)

stop_error.$comment: only the error reason fails the run; the message is redacted-gated

fallback.$comment: the mechanical fallback for future hook event names: x.antigravity.hook.<name> (two segments after the vendor token, per the envelope schema pattern)
